# Issues (server)

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from the code. Edit the code comments, not this file. -->

Issues and their defect-style lifecycle.

## Files

- `issue-records.ts`: Turns issue rows into API records (keys, status, severity, linked records).
- `issue-routes.ts`: Issues: list, raise and move through the defect-style lifecycle.
